references.text: Describes the purchase of the cave of Machpelah from Ephron the Hittite, which became the family burial place.
Jacob asks to be buried in the cave that Abraham bought from the Hittites, noting that Abraham and Sarah are buried there.
Jacob's sons buried him in the cave of Machpelah that Abraham had bought from Ephron the Hittite.
Stephen mentions in his speech that Abraham bought a burial place, testifying to the significance of this purchase in Israel's history.
Confirms the continuity of the family burial site as a sign of God's promise of the land.
Connects the legal transfer of the land with its actual use as the patriarchs' burial place.
Shows the progression from Sarah's burial to Abraham's, confirming the field's status as the family burial place.
Gives the legal definition of the land that 25:10 confirms was used as Abraham's burial place.
Shows the reason (Sarah's death) for Abraham's purchase of the land that later became his own burial place.
